query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS landrace_pyrolysis_profiles (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  landrace_id INT NOT NULL,
  landrace_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  temperature_zone ENUM('vaporization', 'pyrolysis', 'combustion') NOT NULL,
  temperature_min INT,
  temperature_max INT,
  source_molecule_id INT,
  source_molecule_name VARCHAR(255),
  product_molecule_id INT,
  product_molecule_name VARCHAR(255),
  yield_percent DECIMAL(5,2),
  olfactory_impact TEXT,
  health_notes TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_landrace (landrace_id),
  INDEX idx_temperature_zone (temperature_zone),
  INDEX idx_source_molecule (source_molecule_id)
);
